sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể lấy Wi-Fi sân bay ở đâu?

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Open your Wi-Fi settings while you ask. The reply is usually a network name, password, or counter direction.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Hear the place or item first; ở đâu? turns it into the where question.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: Where is immigration, Where is baggage claim, and Where can I buy a SIM card.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it at an airport counter, baggage area, or pickup point before adding the passport, baggage tag, flight detail, or pickup screen as supporting detail.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Directions in Vietnam are often answered with pointing plus a few words. That is useful: watch the gesture first, then ask a follow-up if you need the street, floor, or entrance repeated.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: Where is the pickup area?; Where do I meet the driver?; My bag did not arrive.
